proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8201.6 *pilīla explicitly gives Khowar pilili and Bashkarik pilil ant. These l-l forms select section 6 rather than the pipīla head; Turner notes contamination and uncertain deeper origins throughout this insect family. Exact survey form pīlīlī is preserved.
